answer: Stop sybils with an umber fable wander: an agent stakes a bond for one umber path. Each cycle it wanders the path and tells a fable, a record of its work; verifiers match the tale, voiding a path whose fable is copied or claimed twice, slashing the bond. Forging 1,000 needs 1,000 paths at 17x cost each: each fable fits one umber path and one wander, and cannot be copied, shared, or bulk-bought. Honest agents wander once and keep rights.
